title: Procurement Officer
description:
Procurement Officer – Construction Industry

**Department:** Procurement / Purchase  
**Experience:** 3–8 Years  
**Industry:** Construction / Real Estate  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Reporting To:** Procurement Manager / Purchase Head / Management  
**Job Location:** As per company requirements

1. Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Procurement Officer to manage material purchasing, vendor handling, price negotiations, supplier coordination, and timely delivery of construction materials. The candidate should have a strong understanding of construction materials, market rates, vendor management, and cost control to ensure efficient procurement operations and uninterrupted project execution.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Material Procurement & Purchasing**

* Handle the purchase of construction materials, including cement, steel, sand, aggregates, electrical items, plumbing materials, hardware, and finishing materials.
* Collect material requirements from site engineers and project managers and arrange timely procurement.
* Obtain quotations from multiple vendors and compare prices, quality, specifications, and delivery terms.
* Prepare purchase orders and obtain the necessary approvals before placing orders.
* Ensure materials are procured within approved budgets and delivered according to project schedules.
* Monitor pending purchase requests and prioritise urgent material requirements.

**B. Vendor Handling & Relationship Management**

* Identify, source, evaluate, and onboard reliable vendors, suppliers, and material dealers.
* Develop and maintain a strong network of vendors for different categories of construction materials.
* Handle day-to-day vendor communication regarding quotations, material availability, order confirmation, delivery schedules, and payment terms.
* Build and maintain professional relationships with existing and new vendors.
* Follow up regularly with vendors to ensure timely delivery and resolve supply-related issues.
* Maintain an updated vendor database containing contact details, pricing, negotiated rates, credit periods, and delivery terms.
* Evaluate vendor performance based on pricing, quality, reliability, service, and delivery timelines.
* Develop alternative vendor sources to minimise supply disruptions and dependency on a single supplier.
* Handle vendor complaints, material discrepancies, delayed supplies, and replacement requests.
* Ensure vendors comply with company procurement procedures and agreed commercial terms.

**C. Price Negotiation & Cost Control**

* Negotiate prices, discounts, credit periods, payment terms, transportation charges, and other commercial conditions.
* Conduct market research to understand current material prices and identify cost-saving opportunities.
* Prepare comparative statements and submit recommendations for management approval.
* Ensure purchases meet the required quality standards at competitive prices.
* Track procurement costs and maintain records of negotiated rates and cost savings.
* Coordinate with project teams to identify cost-effective alternatives without compromising quality or specifications.

**D. Site & Inventory Coordination**

* Coordinate with site engineers, project managers, storekeepers, and accounts personnel to understand material requirements.
* Review material indents and ensure purchases are aligned with project priorities.
* Check stock availability before placing new orders to avoid unnecessary purchases and excess inventory.
* Coordinate material transportation and delivery to the appropriate project sites.
* Follow up on material receipt and resolve shortages, incorrect supplies, or quality issues.
* Support proper inventory monitoring and minimise material wastage.

**E. Documentation & Reporting**

* Maintain purchase orders, quotations, comparative statements, vendor records, invoices, and delivery challans.
* Prepare daily or weekly procurement status reports as required by management.
* Track pending purchase orders, delayed deliveries, urgent requirements, and outstanding vendor issues.
* Coordinate with the accounts department regarding vendor invoices, payment follow-ups, and outstanding balances.
* Ensure procurement records are accurate and maintained according to company policies.
* Submit procurement updates and cost-related reports to management whenever required.

3. Educational Qualifications

* Bachelor's degree or Diploma in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
* Relevant experience in construction procurement is preferred.

4. Experience & Skills Required

* 3–8 years of experience in procurement, purchasing, or vendor management, preferably in the construction or real estate industry.
* Good knowledge of construction materials, specifications, brands, and market rates.
* Strong vendor-handling, relationship-management, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to compare quotations and evaluate suppliers effectively.
* Good communication, coordination, and follow-up skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel and purchase documentation.
* Experience with ERP or procurement software is an advantage.
* Ability to manage multiple projects, urgent requirements, and changing priorities.
* Strong commercial awareness, cost-control skills, and problem-solving ability.

5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be assessed based on the following parameters:

* Timely procurement and delivery of construction materials.
* Cost savings achieved through price negotiation.
* Vendor reliability and supplier performance.
* Accuracy and timely completion of purchase orders.
* Compliance with approved budgets and procurement procedures.
* Reduction in material shortages and procurement delays.
* Effective vendor handling and resolution of supply-related issues.
* Proper maintenance of procurement documentation.
* Coordination with site teams and timely closure of purchase requests.

Pay: ₹15,000.00 - ₹40,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

***SOTI does not charge any fees at any stage of the recruitment process. You can verify the authenticity of any SOTI job opportunities by visiting SOTI Careers. SOTI shall not be liable for any fraudulent recruitment activities carried out by unauthorized individuals or organizations.***
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

**What you will do**

* Investigate complex and ambiguous software failures and performance problems.
* Perform deep root-cause analysis across application, system, network, database, and infrastructure layers.
* Analyze application logs, system logs, stack traces, thread dumps, heap dumps, metrics, traces, and profiling data.
* Analyze network traffic and protocols to identify latency, connectivity, retransmission, timeout, and communication issues.
* Investigate issues that occur only under specific workloads, concurrency levels, configurations, environments, or long-running conditions.
* Understand product architecture and critical customer workflows deeply enough to reason about failure modes.
* Learn the product in depth, including core workflows, customer usage patterns, deployment models, and performance-sensitive areas.
* Design experiments to isolate variables and prove or disprove hypotheses.
* Develop diagnostic scripts, instrumentation, and small tools when necessary to accelerate investigations.
* Perform exploratory testing and deliberately challenge system assumptions to discover weaknesses and failure modes.
* Investigate performance degradation, scalability limitations, resource exhaustion, latency spikes, and throughput bottlenecks.
* Create meaningful Performance Test Cases based on product architecture, customer workflows, expected load patterns, scalability goals, and known risk areas.
* Review Performance Test Cases created by other engineers to ensure coverage, clarity, workload relevance, data validity, and alignment with product behavior.
* Execute Performance Test Cases, analyze results, identify bottlenecks or regressions, and communicate findings with clear evidence and recommended actions.
* Correlate evidence across multiple components of distributed systems.
* Work with developers to identify the actual root cause rather than simply identifying the component where the symptom appeared.
* Clearly communicate technical findings, evidence, root cause, impact, and recommended corrective actions.
* Build and maintain diagnostic knowledge, troubleshooting methodologies, and internal technical documentation.

* Experience analyzing logs and traces across multiple components.
* Experience with application profiling and/or performance analysis.
* Hands-on experience creating, reviewing, and executing Performance Test Cases for complex software products.
* Experience diagnosing concurrency, latency, resource contention, or scalability issues.
* Ability to interpret performance test results, compare them with baselines, identify regressions, and connect findings back to product behavior or code-level causes.
* Ability to formulate hypotheses and systematically validate them with evidence.

**2. Behavioral**

* Exceptional curiosity about how software systems work.
* Strong interest in learning the product deeply rather than treating testing as a black-box activity.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Comfortable working with incomplete or ambiguous information.
* Willingness to challenge assumptions.
* Persistence when the first explanation isn't the real root cause.

title: MARINE ELECTRICAL ENGINEER
description:
A **Marine Electrical Engineer** is responsible for designing, installing, testing, and maintaining the electrical, electronic, and power generation systems aboard ships, offshore platforms, and marine structures. They ensure that all electrical equipment complies with international maritime standards, operates efficiently, and maintains safety at sea.

Key Responsibilities

* **System Design & Installation:** Design and oversee the installation of marine electrical systems, including power generation (generators, alternators), distribution switchboards, lighting, propulsion control, and navigation systems.
* **Maintenance & Troubleshooting:** Conduct routine inspections, diagnostic tests, and preventive/corrective maintenance on electrical machinery and automation systems to minimize downtime.
* **Compliance & Safety:** Ensure all electrical systems comply with regulations set by classification societies (e.g., DNV, Lloyd's Register) and international maritime bodies (e.g., IMO, SOLAS, IEEE).
* **Automation & Control:** Work with programmable logic controllers (PLCs), instrumentation, alarm monitoring systems, and dynamic positioning (DP) systems.
* **Project Management:** Collaborate with naval architects, marine engineers, and shipyard personnel during dry-docking, retrofits, and new-build construction projects.
* **Documentation:** Maintain accurate technical logs, electrical schematics, inventory records, and safety reports.

Qualifications & Requirements

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Marine Electrical Engineering, or a related discipline.
* **Certifications:** Relevant STCW certifications (for seagoing roles), such as Electro-Technical Officer (ETO) certification or High Voltage certification, depending on vessel type.
* **Experience:** 2+ years of experience working in shipyards, maritime operations, or offshore energy sectors.
* **Technical Knowledge:** Deep understanding of AC/DC power systems, high-voltage networks, motor controls, switchboards, and marine automation/navigational equipment.

Preferred Skills & Competencies

* **Problem-Solving:** Ability to troubleshoot complex electrical faults under high-pressure conditions at sea.
* **Communication:** Strong technical writing and verbal communication skills to coordinate with multi-national crew members and shore-based management.
* **Physical Fitness:** Ability to pass required marine medical examinations and work in confined or hazardous environments.
